A warm, personality-led Adult Contemporary station mixing international pop, French and Francophone hits, light rock and oldies — all wrapped around local news, sport, and community programming.
profile.targetAudience: French-speaking adults 25–55 in the canton of Fribourg
profile.distinctive: Sole broad-appeal French-language FM station native to the bilingual Fribourg canton. Combines a mainstream pop-to-classic-hits rotation with genuinely local programming — a Fribourg-made show grid, live Fribourg sport coverage, and cultural niches (French chanson, religious slots, regional language Intrè-No).

identity.name: THE STAGE
identity.positioning: Swiss internet radio for Country, Rock, Rockabilly and Americana

profile.description: Swiss internet radio station broadcasting country, rock, Americana, rockabilly and blues — the unofficial Swiss home of the Billboard Country Charts and old-school rock'n'roll, streaming 24/7 from Chur.
profile.targetAudience: Country and rock fans in Switzerland and the German-speaking world
profile.distinctive: Curated themed shows rather than pure auto-rotation — DJ Leo's rockabilly hour, a weekly Billboard Country Countdown, Wolf Räbsamen's Country Rock Saloon and René Maeder's rock-blues mix give the station a hosted feel rare for an internet-only outlet.

reach.region: Switzerland (national internet-only); primarily German-speaking audience

meta.notes: drift.fm redirects to thestage.radio (301). THE STAGE and driftFM are sibling brands under Teak Media Group; catalogId ch-driftfm holds the driftFM stream (radio.co) but the enrichment table rpuId NzU2fjE5OA resolves to THE STAGE (separate Teak Media stream). The now-playing API is CORS-open and serves cover art via Azure Blob Storage signed URLs. No FM/DAB — internet-only. Geo coordinates corrected to Chur (broadcaster HQ); seed geo was RB default.
